context: Make the precondition mechanical rather than a coordination note between two PRs. The mirror should refuse loudly when develop's corpus is not already at the publication fixed point.
description: PR #1542 is an open draft mirroring develop@355cc445, which is the pre-#1537 corpus, so merging it before the re-derivation lands re-publishes the double-hashed pseudonyms and forces a third mirror. Nothing links the two PRs and nothing stops the sync workflow running against a corpus that publishing would rewrite. The gate that would catch this already exists as test_rederived_corpus_publishes_byte_identically_to_what_is_stored; the sync workflow does not reference it (measured).

preserves.behavior: A refusal is loud - a skipped mirror must not look like a successful one
The mirror stays the only writer to published-results
The mirror still runs unattended once its precondition holds; this adds a gate, not a manual step

verifications.description: the sync workflow runs the fixed-point gate before mirroring
verifications.expected: Fails on the unfixed tree today (measured exit 1 - the workflow does not reference the gate)
